Author: Serpens66
Name: Improved Hunters
Description: Adds configurable hunter prey and meat yield for deer, goats, rabbits, camels and chickens.

Changes: Add the shared Mod Settings search with title, optional tooltip and section filtering, safe global-search handoff, and automatic text-field focus.
Generate Portable PDB debug symbols for Unity Mono-compatible stack traces and debugging.
Adds standalone support for the shared per-player identity workaround and marks update-sensitive Script Extender workarounds explicitly.
minor code improvments
fix game localization
Tooltip size test.
Isolated patch and event initialization so one hunter feature cannot disable the rest, and removed scan/event work while the mod is disabled.

Remove the obsolete Reliable Hunter Projectiles setting and its stalled, near-target and projectile-deletion damage compensation; improved pathfinding and visibility handling remain responsible for reaching a valid firing position.
Retain projectile spawn and deletion events only as behavior-neutral observations for the unfinished post-shot path-continuation work, without pending damage intents or calls to DamageUnitRanged.
Updated shared lobby settings for Script Extender 1.42.0 by avoiding redundant UI-only persistence and using the official multiplayer-game signal.
Separate improved target selection, pathfinding, dead-target eligibility and reliable Hunter projectiles into independent synchronized host settings and feature gates.
Split target selection, projectile recovery, active-target reachability, moving-target diagnostics and animal/chicken compatibility out of the central runtime into dedicated source files.
Allow -1 to retain Vanilla meat yield for deer and goats while keeping explicit 0 to 100 yields for non-Vanilla prey.

Keep all chicken target, manual ranged-attack, neutral ownership and granary population behavior bound to HuntChicken, and all other animal compatibility patches bound to their corresponding Hunt setting.
Correct both post-shot recovery validators for Iced's actual Immediate32to64 decoding of the audited 64-bit IMUL instructions, allowing the four-hook recovery transaction to initialize.

Replan an accepted blocked path through Vanilla State 0 and MoveHere when the same live prey has clearly crossed past its stored path anchor, with exact identity, reservation, PCL and geometry guards and one request per accepted path generation.

Add a path-complete fallback and a separate maximum of three moving-target replans while keeping pending visibility conservative, hunt duration unlimited and target, path, order, AI-state, speed and animation fields Vanilla-owned.
Correct the State-9 recovery signature that made version 1.1.64 fail closed by limiting both new semantic byte checks to their exact audited 23-byte hook spans.
Strengthen both recovery-span validators with exact register, immediate, memory-offset and first-instruction-after-the-hook checks before the four-hook transaction can commit.
Skip the native State-9 to State-10 sit/wait transition after a nonlethal shot and immediately return the same validated target to Vanilla State 0 without waiting for projectile deletion.
Reroute a failed direct attack at the end of a stale completed path from Vanilla State 6 to a normal State-0 replan while the original live target remains reachable.

Replace route-length-dependent 60-second hunt limits with progress-based stall detection and a maximum of three recovery-causing attacks per target; exhausted targets enter the existing bounded cooldown.
Correct the State-10 query-call resolver to read the relative displacement after the CALL opcode; version 1.1.62 failed closed during initialization and therefore left Hunter behavior unchanged.
Retain the audited result-hook RVAs and guarded Vanilla State-0/MoveHere continuation while logging the actual CALL instruction addresses separately from their displacement operands.

Correlate each accepted Hunter attack with both audited State-10 target-query exits, including live Hunter/prey identity, health, corpse, own-reservation, PCL, projectile and exact State-6-writer diagnostics.

When the same own-reserved target survives and remains PCL-reachable, select Vanilla's existing State-0 requery path by changing only the State-10 query-result register, then supply that identity once to Vanilla's normal MoveHere handoff.

Reject post-shot continuation for dead, invalid, foreign-targeted, disabled, cooled-down or PCL-disconnected prey, preserving Vanilla's normal corpse, pickup and failure paths without direct AI-state, order, path, speed or animation writes.

Refresh active-target visibility every 250 ms in the attack approach, keep behavior-neutral probes alive across Vanilla's transient reservation-1 scan phase, and bind every visible result to the exact sampled Hunter and prey tiles.
Keep a still-valid known blocked path conservative while its next probe is pending, preventing snapshot expiry from falling into Vanilla's failed close-range attack and return-to-hut path.

Hand a fresh, position-matched visible target through Vanilla's delayed locomotion gate by changing only the gate comparison's captured zero flag after full instruction-span and inbound-control-flow validation; movement, path, target and AI state remain Vanilla-owned.

Record the exact Hunter/prey tile, world and height geometry for every bounded active-target visibility probe, including both validated directional core results even when the authoritative wrapper returns zero.

Distinguish release of the distance override from Vanilla's later locomotion gate so delayed direct attacks can be separated from delayed or stale line-of-sight observations without changing movement, range, path or AI state.

Retain an active visibility tracker across short native scan transitions instead of deleting its snapshot after one uncapturable 100-ms scan, while still expiring genuinely inactive contexts after a bounded two-second interval.

Refresh tracker liveness from both valid persistent scans and valid inline-hook reads, and log the exact first capture rejection plus any eventual bounded expiry without changing movement, range, cooldown or AI state.

Replace the non-monotonic native path-progress restart heuristic with an explicit managed path generation advanced only by the existing validated successful Vanilla MoveHere result, keeping visible snapshots stable throughout one accepted path.

Bind queued visibility probes and their commits to the accepted path generation so an in-flight result can never cross into a newer path, and expose the generation in world-refresh and tile-attack decision logs.
Throttle world-refresh and tile-attack visibility decisions independently so alternating callbacks no longer exhaust the shared diagnostic budget with duplicate entries.

Keep the active visibility tracker stable while the same Vanilla path advances through changing GameUnit +0xF4 locomotion substeps, so a visible snapshot can reach the authoritative tile-distance hook instead of repeatedly returning to first-probe pending.

Retain immediate reprobes for real Hunter, prey, player, map, state, reservation or path-identity changes and for a backwards path-progress jump, while preserving the one-second probe and two-second readable-snapshot bounds.

Move the authoritative blocked-versus-visible decision to the existing tile-distance-28 hook, using an identity-, player-, map- and path-bound visibility snapshot refreshed outside inline hooks at most once per second.

Keep a newly accepted path in Vanilla locomotion during a bounded first-visibility pending window, require a positive active PCL snapshot, and promote the already validated selection PCL result after successful MoveHere so the first attack-range update is covered without another native PCL query.

Log tile attack distance, last world-refresh distance, visibility and PCL snapshot age, reservation, path progress and the exact continue, pending, attack or rejection action without issuing moves or writing speed, animation, path or AI state.

Separate active-Hunter PCL observations from the one-second target-selection cache so an expiry boundary can no longer release a valid blocked-visibility path into Vanilla's destructive near-range target refresh.

Probe each unchanged active Hunter target natively at most once per second and expose the result to the inline continuation hook through a two-second read-only snapshot; log snapshot source, age, misses and aggregate counters without writing movement, speed, animation, path or AI state.

Remove the test-only deer freeze completely after logs and native analysis showed that skipping OnUnitMovement bypasses Vanilla tile-position and tile-occupancy synchronization, which can leave living deer invisible or lead to later deletion.
Restore fully Vanilla deer movement for repeatable LOS calibration attempts; no deer movement event is intercepted and no deer state is changed by Improved Hunters.

Add a clearly marked test-only deer freeze in a separate file: living deer skip the Script Extender's existing OnUnitMovement original handler in singleplayer without a new native hook or position, speed and AI-state writes; death and corpse handling remain untouched.

Rename directional visibility diagnostics to the explicit hunter-to-prey and prey-to-hunter endpoints after the 1.1.52 log proved that Vanilla's positive diagonal-wall wrapper result matched only the prey-to-hunter core result.

Compare a positive Hunter visibility wrapper result with the validated native core in both directions only in the state-1 near range, logging wrapper, forward and reverse results to expose diagonal or corner disagreements without adding a hook or simulating a projectile.

Keep the existing Vanilla path when either direction remains blocked, but skip the destructive distance-20 refresh and hand off to Vanilla's direct attack without a continuation ticket when both directions report clear visibility.

Keep an already valid blocked-visibility Hunter path across Vanilla's distance-20 refresh by selecting the untouched greater-than-20 branch with the existing safe compare hook, without writing speed, animation, movement, path, order or AI-state fields.

Couple the near-refresh bypass and distance-29 continuation through a one-use ticket guarded by reservation, path progress, cached PCL reachability and native visibility; remove the repeated state-0/MoveHere fallback and add bounded preparation, consumption and rejection logs.

Add read-only movement snapshots at the validated near-refresh, MoveHere, distance-29 continuation and visibility callbacks to isolate the special-case sitting/waiting animation without adding another native hook.
Correlate animation, locomotion control, both speed fields, AI state, target, path progress and position while leaving the normal coupled Vanilla speed/animation stages unchanged.
Move the state-1 near-refresh context hook to the safe compare boundary at RVA 0x130019, leaving Vanilla's far-branch target at RVA 0x13002D outside the 15-byte detour span.

Replace the unsafe result detour with the exact 14-byte query/test/actor-load span at RVA 0x12FF2E; validate all direct HunterUpdate branches fail-closed and clear only Vanilla's Zero Flag for the guarded state-0 handoff.
Keep a Hunter's own live reservation-2 prey eligible across Vanilla's near-target state-1 refresh, while rejecting stale identities and prey reserved by another Hunter.

Supply only the validated target ID at Vanilla's query return and carry it briefly into the regular state-0 acquisition, leaving target assignment, reservation, path creation, movement and AI-state writes to Vanilla.
Correct the packed Hunter path-buffer address: Vanilla applies offset 0xB4FE78 to GameUnitManager, yielding effective module RVA 0x7337278 in the audited DLL.
Validate the Script Extender manager pointer against the exact-hash RVA before enabling remaining-path speed recovery, preserving fail-open Vanilla behavior on any mismatch.
Decode each Hunter's remaining packed Vanilla path and use its cardinal-plus-diagonal Manhattan cost to select only an existing faster Vanilla movement stage while direct visibility remains blocked.
Keep the correction exact-hash-only, singleplayer-only, bounded per Hunter and fail-open; write no speed, animation, path, order or AI-state field and preserve Vanilla's final visible approach.
Revalidate each active state-1 Hunter target through the existing persistent scan and the one-second PCL cache, so newly disconnected prey is rejected before the old path reaches a new wall.

Invalidate only the stale target identity and release its guarded reservation, then let HunterUpdate's own identity-failure branch stop the old order, run Vanilla target search and issue any replacement movement.
Reject prey in disconnected Path Connection Layers before heuristic ranking and again at the concrete Vanilla candidate handoff, using the same player and mode inputs as MoveHere.
Cache unchanged connectivity for at most one second, recheck immediately when PCL inputs change, fail open on query errors, and leave positive results to Vanilla's detailed path creation.
Add a separately removable, observation-only calibration of the native player-aware Path Connection Layer reachability query before Hunter target ranking.

Compare mode 0, mode 2 and the Hunter's exact MoveHere mode field, then correlate the stored result with Vanilla's immediate MoveHere return without issuing movement orders or changing target selection.

Reject a prey candidate for the affected Hunter after Vanilla's native MoveHere proves it unreachable, even when every cached candidate is currently rejected and target selection would otherwise fall back to Vanilla.

Retry each unreachable Hunter/prey pair after five minutes, while keeping the result independent per Hunter and preventing later short target-abort cooldowns from shortening the reachability retry window.
Route the Hunter's Hut through Vanilla's normal building-height visibility case so it blocks targeting like other buildings instead of allowing arrows that can collide with it.
Validate and restore the single native dispatch entry safely, and keep the correction disabled in real multiplayer and the map editor pending multiplayer synchronization support.
Remove the temporary global two-identity-per-map limit so every Hunter can independently and repeatedly continue Vanilla paths for changing prey throughout the match.
Retain only per-Hunter progress and time safety bounds with a short retry cooldown, and log continuation starts plus real path progress instead of every native callback.

Continue an already active Vanilla Hunter path through the blocked-line-of-sight distance-28 transition by selecting Vanilla's existing distance-29 stage, without issuing another movement order or writing target, path, order, or AI-state fields.

Require the validated native visibility result and live path progress, release immediately for clear sight, and bound the removable singleplayer diagnostic by path progress, time, callbacks, and target identities.

Add a removable observation-only hook after Vanilla's state-1 direct attack call to correlate its exact native distance, result, target identity, and current path fields with the preceding accepted state-0 MoveHere.

Preserve correlations for long Vanilla approaches so the normal out-of-range obstacle navigation and the near-range blocked-line-of-sight abort can be measured without issuing movement or changing AI state.
Correlate Vanilla's existing nonzero state-0 prey result with the same immediate MoveHere return that already guards injected hidden candidates, without changing accepted Vanilla movement.

Put Vanilla-selected but unreachable prey into the existing 30-second Hunter target cooldown and apply the same guarded target/reservation cleanup, while logging accepted paths for the remaining back-and-forth analysis.

Add a removable singleplayer target-search fallback that supplies a fully validated hidden prey candidate only when Vanilla's complete Hunter query returns no target, then leaves reservation, movement, and AI-state progression to Vanilla's original state-0 path.

Observe Vanilla's immediate MoveHere result, cool down unreachable candidates, and clean only the rejected attempt's guarded target identity and reservation so enclosed prey cannot leave Hunters or other prey stuck.
Remove the temporary behavior-changing MoveHere diagnostic after its query lock and isolated AI-state continuation caused stale-target movement, delayed reactions, and Hunter return loops.
Keep production line-of-sight recovery fail-closed and retain only behavior-neutral visibility and state diagnostics for the next native analysis step.
Continue an accepted state-6 diagnostic approach through Vanilla's audited AI state 1 transition, including exact target-global and prey-reservation readback guards.
Observe moving prey and Hunter state changes for 30 seconds, keep only the current prey query eligible during the approach, and permit a bounded retry after Vanilla returns to state 6.
Correlate the removable MoveHere diagnostic with Vanilla's debounced Hunter search cycles and test the current native target context after three unsuccessful searches in AI state 6.
Record the calibrated reachable-return-1 and fully-blocked-return-0 distinction while keeping the productive recovery fail-closed and free of managed path searches.
Extend the removable MoveHere diagnostic to test one stable pre-shot Hunter state after two seconds without a projectile, covering blocked targets that never produce a second abort burst.
Log Hunter AI/context state and every subsequent hooked MoveHere event so native path acceptance can be separated from later Vanilla order replacement.
Remove synchronous managed path searches from Hunter recovery and target ranking after an unreachable-prey case could freeze the game thread.
Add a removable singleplayer-only MoveHere diagnostic that correlates exact native acceptance with bounded Hunter path-state and movement progress observations.
Limit explicit chicken AttackUnit compatibility overrides to projectile-capable ranged units, leaving Vanilla's rejection intact for melee and support units.
Preserve all volatile CPU registers around the explicit chicken AttackUnit callback, preventing the post-callback native crash while retaining manual attacks and Hunter-only automatic targeting.
Allow explicit AttackUnit orders against live chickens to pass Vanilla's separate non-Hunter compatibility rejection while retaining the Hunter-only automatic target dispatch.
Replace the fixed delayed KillUnit arrow workaround with validated Vanilla ranged damage while the matching Hunter projectile is still alive, preserving the normal pickupable corpse transition.
Track projectile slot and global identity, compensate only stalled, near-target or deleting arrows, and expire unresolved intents without creating synthetic 0x6F corpses.

Move Hunters to a nearby pathfinder-confirmed firing tile after three building-blocked pre-shot target aborts, while treating post-shot target changes as normal and retaining the Hunter-hut visibility exception.
Remove the temporary native visibility hooks after the first blocked-order test exposed an unsafe callback context and caused a desktop crash.
Move blocked Hunter visibility and movement diagnostics to the existing safe 100-ms unit scan while retaining target identity, terrain, building and projectile correlation.
Throttle unchanged waiting-position observations to one entry every two seconds and keep the complete diagnostic isolated for later removal.
Add an isolated, behavior-neutral Hunter visibility diagnostic for native order-helper rejection and the following state-6 transition.

Correlate rejected orders and successful projectile spawns with Hunter/chicken identities, positions, elevations, look-at coordinates, straight-line terrain heights and intersected building types without bypassing building visibility.
Confirm matching native Hunter actor captures and retain direct-RVA resolution on the audited DLL with unique semantic pattern fallback on changed hashes.
Reconstruct the native Hunter ID before target-query handling as a temporary workaround for Script Extender issue 123, and leave Vanilla unchanged when the actor cannot be validated.
Use direct validated RVAs for the audited CrusaderDE.dll and unique executable-section pattern resolution for changed DLL hashes; disable only native features whose semantic validation fails.
Replace Vanilla's food/population chicken target with a configurable host limit per player while retaining Vanilla's granary selection, timing and unit creation.
Create new granary chickens directly as neutral units and track them by source player, unit slot and global ID so dead chickens permit exactly one replacement.
Reconstruct loaded chickens deterministically from their previous owner or nearest active granary and leave unrelated fresh chicken spawns unchanged.
Release stale prey reservations immediately when a hunter cancels or changes its target, while retaining the periodic cleanup as an independent fallback.
Validate hunter meat event unit IDs before native lookups and log reservation outcomes with millisecond timestamps and readback values.
Prevent non-hunter ranged and siege units from automatically targeting neutralized chickens while preserving explicit attack orders.
Keep hunters on Vanilla's hunter-only automatic animal target path and restore the native dispatch entry when chicken hunting is disabled.
Highlighted the activation control and standardized larger, wider settings tooltips.
Reordered the settings introduction and topic sections, corrected German labels, and added opaque wrapping tooltips.
Use locally validated reference RVAs for camel and chicken despawn patches on the supported DLL.
Added two automatically saved lobby-settings presets with migration of existing settings to preset 1.
Remove obsolete hunter building availability workaround code.
Remove temporary diagnostic logs for animal detection, hunter target queries and scan summaries.
Keep only the active Improved Hunters runtime behavior and essential warning logs.
Remove the temporary non-hunter chicken projectile and target-state workaround because it could leave ranged units stuck in shooting animations.
Clear automatic non-hunter ranged targets against chickens while chicken hunting is enabled.
Allow explicit AttackUnit orders against chickens for a short time so manual attacks remain possible.
Add diagnostics for cleared chicken auto-targets.
Convert player-owned chickens to nature-owned chickens while chicken hunting is enabled.
Use OnUnitCreate to make newly spawned chickens nature-owned before the original spawn runs.
Remove the temporary delayed test animal/unit spawn diagnostics.
Trigger the delayed test animal/unit spawn from the native scan loop instead of the Script Extender timer engine.
Use the StartConditions-style single spawn tile per keep for the delayed chicken/deer spawn test.
Spawn one player-owned arab slinger at the same test position to verify unit spawning.
Force hunter building availability again immediately after spawning the test deer.
Also spawn one owner=0 test deer near every keep together with the delayed owner=0 test chickens.
Spawn ten owner=0 test chickens near every keep five seconds after map start while chicken hunting is enabled.
Add logs for the owner=0 chicken spawn test to diagnose whether chicken ownership blocks hunter targeting.
Accept hunter target queries for valid prey even when the Script Extender reports an invalid hunter id.
Add more detailed invalid hunter target query diagnostics.
Repeat the delayed hunter building availability refresh several times after map start.
Add detailed hunter building availability diagnostics and force a build screen refresh when enabled prey exists.
Add hunter scan, requery and invalid target query diagnostics for chicken hunting.
Mark collected short-lived prey corpses for deletion immediately after pickup.
Allow chickens with player ownership flags to become eligible hunter targets.
Delay and retry the hunter building availability workaround after map start.
Increase arrow damage against animal camels while camel hunting is enabled for more reliable hunter kills.
Only re-enable the hunter building on map start when at least one enabled Improved Hunters prey animal exists on the loaded map.
Add diagnostic logs for chicken detection and hunter target queries.
Re-enable the hunter building on map start when the mod has extra prey enabled.
Extend corpse despawn time for camels and chickens while their hunting options are enabled.
Allow chickens to be selected as hunter targets without changing chicken ownership.
Renamed Hunt Rabbits to Improved Hunters.
Added lobby settings to enable or disable the mod, configure huntable animal types and set meat yield per animal.
Added support for deer, goats, rabbits, camels and player-owned granary chickens.
Preserve the hunter's mandatory initial walk to the hunter post before allowing rabbit searches.
Remove rabbit corpses immediately after a hunter collects them.
Prefer nearby rabbits by removing the base game's minimum target distance for rabbits only.
Let idle wandering hunters immediately repeat the native target search when an unreserved rabbit is within the normal hunting radius.
Keep slain rabbits for about one minute (1800 game ticks) so hunters can reach and collect them.
Trace hunter AI state and target assignment after rabbits are accepted by the target hook.
Keep the runtime, event subscriptions and rabbit despawn patch active when the BepInEx manager is destroyed after bootstrap.
Run diagnostics through map, unit and coroutine triggers and log the complete plugin lifecycle.
Add direct native unit polling and machine-code verification for diagnostics.
Add targeted diagnostics for rabbit eligibility and hunter target queries.
Allow hunters to select rabbits as hunting targets.
Keep slain rabbits on the map long enough for hunters to collect them.
